observation.visible_scene: A static outdoor view of a parking lot beside a single-story building with a brown roof on the right. In the left foreground stands a large white parabolic satellite dish on a blue support frame, set on a grassy slope. A row of parked cars (a dark SUV, a white sedan, a dark sedan, a silver hatchback, a dark-blue sedan, a white SUV, a dark SUV, and a second white SUV) lines the asphalt lot, with a small freestanding sign and a tall light pole in the middle ground. Bare-branched trees frame the right edge and the horizon. The sky is dominated by a thick layer of grey-and-white clouds.
visible_changes: The cloud cover gradually shifts and reorganizes across the sky over the excerpt: the bright central cloud mass changes shape and edges, and progressively more patches of blue sky open up, most noticeably in the upper-right quadrant, while the lower-left cloud bank also thins and drifts slightly.

Foreground and midground elements remain fixed: the satellite dish, the building, the light pole, the sign, and every parked car keep the same pixel positions and orientations from the first to the last frame, indicating no object translation and no camera pan/zoom.
The bare tree branches at the right edge show at most very subtle motion, consistent with the rest of the scene being otherwise still.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the clip is real-time or a time-lapse (the cloud evolution is visible but its true timescale is not determinable from the frames alone).
Any weather change before or after this segment, and whether the increasing blue sky represents clearing or just momentary gaps.
The presence or absence of moving people/vehicles outside the cropped window.
uncertain_details: The exact direction and speed of cloud drift is hard to pin down because the changes are subtle between adjacent frames.
Minor sway of the thin tree branches is not clearly resolvable and may be compression noise rather than motion.
